notes.title: Major Updates and fixes
notes.content:
[h1]due to the last reviews about the controls and some other issues , we have just finished an update fixing the following :[/h1]

- Clear indication for using doors and other objects : now you see a message telling you ; you are missing lockpicks or an item to open doors and use on objects.

- fixed the controller / mouse issue in the lockpicking scene : before this update if you tried to use the mouse after the controller when in picklocking scene , it would behave not like it's supposed to.

- made clearer instruction how to open doors with controller : you press the right stick and move it at the same time ; since some players thought that they have to press X and move the right stick.

- Added Full Controller support in all the menu's : no longer now you have to use your mouse and keyboard to navigate through the game.

- Made it clear that the noise meter on the top left is for the encounter risk with monsters; some players didnt know what it was for .

i hope that with these updates , you will enjoy the game more :) , please feel free to give me any further feedback .
happy gaming.
